name: Dark sixteenths: four on the floor, sixteenth hats, a dark mix with decaying tails

provenance.segmentation: key-stability segments >=150 s from a 20 s/45 s chroma key track; up to two 96 s groove chunks per track
provenance.segmentationNote: v1's own coherent stretches, reused and not re-cut (CORPUS.md: a key segment is not guaranteed to be one track — two tracks in the same key back to back merge into one entry and a track that modulates splits into two).
provenance.box: the members' 2.5th to 97.5th percentile on every bird — the middle half widened symmetrically until at least 50% of the members sit inside on all eight birds at once — then stretched to include the medoid; the coverage is in reading.coverage
provenance.rates: onsets per bar in three bands — 40-120 Hz, 300-2000 Hz, 6-11 kHz — keyed by the role each band stands in for. They are band proxies and not source separation: a bassline that moves inside the low band is a low-band onset and a clap is a mid-band one.
provenance.words: every class word is a tercile of the corpus itself; the cut points are in notes/analysis/mining-v2.md
provenance.name: the class words at least half the members agree on, and the medoid's own where they do not — so a name may describe the medoid where `wants` stays silent, which is the honest way round: a name is a description and a want is an instruction.
provenance.note: A candidate, not a row of the library. Only `score` and `verdicts` are the listener's own, and no tool writes them.
provenance.unit: one coherent stretch, taken as the median of its own eight-bar windows

mined.name: four on the floor, hats on the sixteenths, a dark mix, full low end, decaying tails, a centred stage

port.read: rates.figure and rates.offbeat lean the stab and hat masks (and the figure rate the density budget); figures.brightness and figures.sustain are class words, a tercile of the list each leans (brightness on the lead, pad and stab lists, sustain on the lead and stab)
lost: rates.kick {"perBar":4.688,"min":4.344,"max":5.344}: the 40-120 Hz band is the kick and the bass together, and a four-floor kick is four a bar
port.admitted: by its family key's region (House / Deep House, the house spell +/- 0.15 on every bird); the mined box is readings and is never held against dice
port.placement: GA5: the mined sets are four on the floor with the drums in; a drumless theme (Ember under 0.18) is not one, so the row places only where the drums play

medoid.note: one member of the cluster, the nearest to its middle — not an average
